You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 41024fbb0ab6fed1563aec6644370162dece701a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Higor=20Eur=C3=ADpedes?= <heuripedes@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2017 19:54:32 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] Fix conditional jump on uninitialized data

This fixes a bug introduced in 862cf481081f58e3961c6dc1430af67ac147f828
---
 tasks/task_image.c | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/tasks/task_image.c b/tasks/task_image.c
index bae218960e..72b31d383a 100644
--- a/tasks/task_image.c
+++ b/tasks/task_image.c
@@ -322,6 +322,7 @@ bool task_push_image_load(const char *fullpath, retro_task_callback_t cb, void *
    image->status                     = IMAGE_STATUS_TRANSFER;
    image->is_blocking                = false;
    image->is_blocking_on_processing  = false;
+   image->is_finished                = false;
    image->processing_final_state     = 0;
    image->processing_pos_increment   = 0;
    image->pos_increment              = 0;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the use of the `image->is_finished` variable without it being properly initialized. This could lead to undefined behavior, especially if the program attempted to access or evaluate the value of `is_finished` before it was set to a defined state (`true` or `false`). By initializing `image->is_finished` to `false`, the patch ensures that the variable has a known value before any conditional jumps or logic operations involving it, thus preventing unpredictable behavior from uninitialized data.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the use of the `image->is_finished` variable without it being properly initialized. This could lead to undefined behavior, especially if the program attempted to access or evaluate the value of `is_finished` before it was set to a defined state (`true` or `false`). By initializing `image->is_finished` to `false`, the patch ensures that the variable has a known value before any conditional jumps or logic operations involving it, thus preventing unpredictable behavior from uninitialized data.
